newsitem.title: USA: NAI unit gets $17 mln in contract award.
newsitem.headline: NAI unit gets $17 mln in contract award.

text.p: NAI Technologies Inc said on Wednesday its British Lynwood subsidiary, had received new contract awards with a total initial value of over $17 million.
The contract awards, placed by three major customers in Europe, are for hardware systems engineering, design and development, standard rugged product and support services.
NAI Technologies is a diversified international electronics and telecommunications company.
